title: CHMMOTv1 - Cardiac and Hepatic Multi-Echo (T2*) MRI Images and Clinical Dataset for Iron Overload on Thalassemia Patients
reasoning: The paper describes the creation and characteristics of a medical imaging dataset (CHMMOTv1) for thalassemia patients. It focuses on technical aspects of the data, imaging protocols, and clinical information, without any component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
